In a separate development, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced via a video posted to X that the Pentagon and the DOJ have created a joint task force to identify and prosecute unauthorized disclosures of sensitive military information to the press, marking an escalation of the Trump administration's crackdown on leaks. CNN host Jake Tapper publicly called Hegseth's move hypocritical.

Oil prices jumped more than 5% to over $80/barrel and US and global stocks fell on the escalation. The IMF cut its 2026 global growth forecast to 3%, warning the energy shock from the Iran conflict is cooling global growth, though it said the impact is 'better than feared'. South Korea's outlook was revised up as chip exports offset the war's drag. Trump threatened to cut all trade with Spain. Iran has accused the US of violations. Iraqi PM Al-Zaidi visited the White House and met Trump in the Oval Office; the US is pressing Baghdad to reduce Iran's influence in Iraq, and Iraq-based Iran-allied militias have threatened to fight the US. The US and Iraq confirmed a full US military withdrawal from Iraq by the end of September, linked to disarmament of Iran-backed militias.
